mapper.select: select sum(re.score) from sys_role r left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_result re on re.u_id = u.user_id left join sys_task ta on re.task_id = ta.id where re.p_id = #{pId} and ta.category = #{category} GROUP BY r.role_name

SELECT SUM(re.score) FROM sys_result re JOIN sys_task ta ON re.task_id = ta.id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = re.u_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE re.is_finish = 1 AND re.p_id = #{pId} AND u.user_id = #{teacher} GROUP BY ta.category
select task_id from sys_result where p_id=#{pId} and u_id=#{teacherId}
select count(*) from sys_result where (p_id = #{pId} and u_id = #{uId}) and (is_finish = 0 or is_finish = 1)
select count(*) from sys_result where date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m') = concat(#{year},'-',#{month}) and u_id=#{userId}
select evidence from sys_result
select distinct year(start_time) from sys_project
